subject: Reopened: review CHANGES REQUIRED (1 high, 2 medium, 4 low) — decisions inside
body:
reviewer-opus: CHANGES REQUIRED at 6ea3f87. Lead decisions:

1. HIGH — Firefox content-process crash (signal 11) when axe runs while the page is loading/busy (shell.spec:98/119, auth.spec:90/175, Split View 320; CI run 43843684814). NOT sandbox load. DECISION (shared with segment 01, same root cause — implement exactly this, no skips): in `apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts` `expectNoAxeViolations`, run axe against a FROZEN copy of the page: capture `page.content()` (plus computed state you need, e.g. inline the adopted/linked CSS), open a fresh page in the same context with JavaScript disabled, `setContent` the snapshot, and run the full axe rule set there; aggregate and assert as today. Use it on all browsers (simplest, consistent), or at minimum on Firefox, with a comment citing the crash evidence. Prove: Firefox suite ≥5 consecutive runs with zero crashes, and violation results identical to live-page axe on Chromium for every page. Then show the Firefox CI job green. Coordinate the exact helper with the segment-01 implementer via the lead (I'm sending them the same design) — identical code on both branches so the merge is trivial.
2. MEDIUM — global sign-out doesn't revoke API access. DECISION: fix now. In the user-tx path, look up `auth.sessions` by the token's `session_id` (indexed, cached ~30 s) and return 401 `session_revoked` when absent; e2e: device B gets 401 from /api/me after device A's global sign-out. Keep the Account copy accurate.
3. MEDIUM — tests can load real secrets / touch the hosted project. DECISION: unit + db tests always start from a cleared env and add back only explicit local values; `test_auth_db` uses `require_local` and is not marked integration; e2e refuses a non-loopback SUPABASE_URL unless `E2E_ALLOW_HOSTED=1`; the live-auth task sets that explicitly. Add a test that fails if a non-local URL plus real-looking secrets reach Settings in tests.
4. LOW-MED — admin "verified email" read from user-editable user_metadata. DECISION: read `auth.users.email_confirmed_at` (DB) for the admin decision; test that editing user_metadata can't grant or revoke admin.
5. LOW — implicit-token callback allows login CSRF. DECISION: remove the implicit `#access_token` branch entirely (PKCE + token_hash remain); test that a fragment session is ignored.
6. LOW — real PKCE email path untested. DECISION: add a local mail catcher (e.g. mailpit) to the local/CI auth stack and an e2e (WebKit) that sends a real magic link, follows it through /verify → /auth/callback?code=, and lands signed in.
7. LOW — live-auth script: assert the owner-session logout returns 204; sweep stale `naadi-e2e-live-*` users at start; document in docs/RUNBOOK.md that `--owner` replaces outstanding owner magic links and updates last sign-in.

Also: agents share the session scratchpad directory — keep your temp files inside your worktree (e.g. `.tmp/`, gitignored) or a subfolder named after you.
Re-run everything (unit, db, e2e matrix with 2 workers), integrate, post done.
